description: EMCO Industries Limited, known as EMCO, manufactures high- and low-voltage electrical porcelain insulators and substation products. Its parent, The Imperial Electric Company (Pvt.) Ltd., was established in 1931; insulator manufacture in Lahore began in 1951 and a full insulator plant followed in 1954 using Japanese and French machinery and know-how.
headOffice: 4th Floor, National Tower, 28-Egerton Road, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: Company website (emco.com.pk: about, product categories, contacts) and the company's own FY2025 annual accounts on that site (registered office, chief executive), read 2026-10-17.
